title: ComplianceConfig
description: The on-chain compliance configuration written by set_config and read by the enforcement evaluator. Policy is the external safeguard-policy contract address (null when enforcement runs policy-free); sac_passthrough composes the bound SAC's authorized() view. config_version is the monotonic rewrite counter kept by the contract (0 until the first write); it is stored separately on-chain but included here for event/fixture completeness.

policy.description: The configured policy contract address, or null for no policy gate.

sac_passthrough.description: When true, each fund-holding party must also be authorized() on the token's bound SAC.

config_version.description: Monotonic rewrite counter; informational in config records.

address.description: Stellar address: G… for accounts, C… for contracts. Fixtures may use abbreviated placeholders.
